description.value: Little Spoon Ice Cream is an artisan small-batch ice cream maker founded by two friends on BC's Sunshine Coast, crafting flavors from clean, scratch-made ingredients in Gibsons. Their creative lineup spans classic and inventive flavors — including vegan options — and their products are distributed across BC. The OSM node places a location on West Broadway in Vancouver, though the relationship to the Gibsons home base is unclear from available evidence.
